About

The creator

Harpreet Raj Singh™ designs games that turn real-world challenges (national development, clean energy, climate and the Global Goals) into decisions you can feel.

Mission

The Harpreet Raj Singh App of productive edutainment games for progressive youth and adults of the 21st Century, to steer this Century in a positive direction.

Every game is built on three principles: grounded (real baselines and official targets, clearly separated from invented mechanics), fair (every choice has trade-offs), and playful (humour and surprise, never a lecture).

Disclaimers

  • These games are educational simulations, not forecasts. Real-world baselines are cited in-game; future dynamics and scores are simplified game mechanics.
  • Viksit Bharat 2047 is an independent work. It is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by the Government of India, NITI Aayog or any ministry or agency. Programme names and targets are referenced for education and commentary.
  • SDG 2030 is an independent work. It is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by the United Nations. Sustainable Development Goal names and colours are used for educational purposes; no UN emblem is used. “Veridia” and its rival nations are fictional.
  • Harpreet Raj Singh™ and the game titles are the creator's marks.

Settings

Your data

Everything is stored only on this device.

Privacy policy

Effective date: 17 October 2026 · App: Harpreet Raj Singh Games · Developer: Harpreet Raj Singh

The short version

We collect no personal data. None. There are no accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking and no third-party SDKs that collect data.

What is stored, and where

The app saves the following only on your device (browser local storage / app storage), so the games can work:

  • your settings (sound, vibration, motion, text size)
  • your in-progress game saves
  • your best scores
  • whether you have finished each tutorial

This information never leaves your device and is never sent to us or anyone else.

Network use

The games run fully offline. The app makes no network requests of its own. If you tap a source link (for example, an IMF or government page cited in a game), that page opens in your web browser, and that website's own privacy policy applies.

Deleting your data

Use Settings → Delete saves & scores, clear the app's storage in your device settings, or uninstall the app.

Children

The games are designed for teens and adults. Because no personal data is collected, no data about children is collected either.

Changes

If this policy ever changes, the new version will be published in the app with a new effective date.
